sources.title: How to Exploit the Same Vulnerability of MetaPool in Two Different Ways
sources.short_quote: Here we take one attack transaction as a concrete example to illustrate the process.
sources.source_section: 0x4. The New Attack Method of the Saddle Finance Incident
sources.facts: Identifies the nominated metapool and exact representative attack hash. Describes vulnerable swap scaling and repeated exploit executions. This closes the role of the linked transaction, but not the entire incident inventory.

sources.title: Audius Governance Takeover Post-Mortem 7/23/22
sources.short_quote: 23:11:36 UTC - Suspicious token transfer occurs on-chain as a result
sources.facts: Links initial attempt 0x3bbb15f... at22:54:37, second initialization/proposal 0xfefd829... at23:10:12 and treasury extraction 0x4227bca... at23:11:36. Proposal84 failed quorum; proposal85 executed. The failed governance attempt is distinct from Ethereum transaction reversion. Lists governance, staking and delegation components.

sources.title: XCarnival NFT lending protocol vulnerability analysis
sources.short_quote: Preparing for the attack — the transaction that generated the order
sources.facts: Explicitly identifies preparation0x61a6a893... and borrowing0x51cbfd46.... Describes collateral withdrawal leaving reusable orders and subsequent native-ETH borrowing through xToken. Explains only one example, so the linked hashes are not a complete execution inventory. Report calendar wording June27 differs from indexed UTC June26.
